historical_references.reference: Aneri was an Apsara, or celestial nymph, in Hindu mythology. She is often depicted as playing the vina, a type of stringed instrument that is said to have been given to her by Lord Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, and arts.

Aneri is also mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic, as the wife of Bhishma Pitamaha, the grandsire of the Kuru dynasty. According to the text, Aneri was a beautiful and virtuous woman who was devoted to her husband and was highly respected by everyone in the kingdom.
